name: Dhanlaxmi Fabrics Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1980, Dhanlaxmi Fabric Ltd is
engaged in manufacturing and processing of Textile and allied products/services and Power Generation.
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio:[1]
a) Fabric: Cotton, Viscose, Polyester, Blended, Lycra as Pure White, Reactive or Vat Dyed, Pigment, Reactive, Prints, Disperse or Dis-change print with finishes as required by customers.
b) Yarn: Pure White, Reactive or Vat Dyed Cotton, Rayon, Polyester or Blended yarn.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.04 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -31.1% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -7.40% over last 3 years.
